#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <cstring>
using namespace std;

struct Edge {
    int u, v, c, r;
    Edge(int uu, int vv, int cc, int rr): u(uu), v(vv), c(cc), r(rr) {}
};

vector<Edge> E;
vector<vector<int>> ady;

int maxflow(int source, int sink) {
    int total_flow = 0;
    while (true) {
        vector<int> prev(ady.size(), -1);
        queue<int> Q;
        Q.push(source);
        while (!Q.empty()) {
            int u = Q.front(); Q.pop();
            for (int e : ady[u]) {
                int v = E[e].v;
                if (E[e].c == 0 || prev[v] >= 0) continue;
                Q.push(v);
                prev[v] = e;
            }
        }
        if (prev[sink] < 0) break;
        int flow = INT_MAX;
        for (int x = sink; x != source; x = E[prev[x]].u) {
            flow = min(flow, E[prev[x]].c);
        }
        for (int x = sink; x != source; x = E[prev[x]].u) {
            E[prev[x]].c -= flow;
            E[E[prev[x]].r].c += flow;
        }
        total_flow += flow;
    }
    return total_flow;
}

void add_edge(int u, int v, int c, bool directed = true) {
    E.emplace_back(u, v, c, (int)E.size() + 1);
    ady[u].push_back(E.size() - 1);
    E.emplace_back(v, u, directed ? 0 : c, (int)E.size() - 1);
    ady[v].push_back(E.size() - 1);
}

const int MAX = 11;
int n, t;
char S[MAX][MAX][65], R[MAX][MAX];
int dx[4] = {1, -1, 0, 0};
int dy[4] = {0, 0, 1, -1};

void simulateZ() {
    for (int i = 0; i < t; ++i) {
        for (int x = 0; x < n; ++x)
            for (int y = 0; y < n; ++y)
                S[x][y][i + 1] = S[x][y][i];
        for (int x = 0; x < n; ++x) {
            for (int y = 0; y < n; ++y) {
                if (S[x][y][i] == 'Z') {
                    for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                        int nx = dx[k] + x;
                        int ny = dy[k] + y;
                        if (nx >= 0 && ny >= 0 && nx < n && ny < n && S[nx][ny][i] != 'Y') {
                            S[nx][ny][i + 1] = 'Z';
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

struct State {
    int x, y, d;
    State(int xx, int yy, int dd): x(xx), y(yy), d(dd) {}
};

bool seen[MAX][MAX][65];

int getId(int x, int y, int col) {
    return x * col + y;
}

int inNode(int u) {
    return u + n * n;
}

int outNode(int u) {
    return u;
}

    memset(seen, 0, sizeof(seen));
    queue<State> Q;
    Q.emplace(x, y, 0);
    seen[x][y][0] = true;
    while (!Q.empty()) {
        State act = Q.front(); Q.pop();
        if (act.d > t) continue;
        if (R[act.x][act.y] > '0' && R[act.x][act.y] <= '9') {
            add_edge(getId(x, y, n), inNode(getId(act.x, act.y, n)), R[act.x][act.y] - '0', false);
        }
        if (S[act.x][act.y][act.d] == 'Z') continue;
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
            int nx = dx[i] + act.x;
            int ny = dy[i] + act.y;
            if (nx >= 0 && ny >= 0 && nx < n && ny < n && S[nx][ny][act.d] != 'Y' && S[nx][ny][act.d] != 'Z' && !seen[nx][ny][act.d]) {
                seen[nx][ny][act.d] = true;
                Q.emplace(nx, ny, act.d + 1);
            }
        }
    }
}

    cin >> n >> t;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
            cin >> S[i][j][0];
    simulateZ();
    int source = 2 * n * n + n * n;
    int sink = 2 * n * n + n * n + 1;
    E.clear();
    ady.assign(5 * n * n, vector<int>());
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            cin >> R[i][j];
            if (R[i][j] > '0' && R[i][j] <= '9') {
                add_edge(inNode(getId(i, j, n)), inNode(getId(i, j, n)), R[i][j] - '0', false);
                add_edge(inNode(getId(i, j, n)), sink, 1 << 30, false);
            }

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            if (R[i][j] > '0' && R[i][j] <= '9') {
                bfs(i, j);
                add_edge(source, getId(i, j, n), R[i][j] - '0', false);
            }
        }
    cout << maxflow(source, sink) << "\n";
    return 0;
